about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, brakes, steering and suspension, tires and wheels. We work out of Pawleys Island and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Kane Greene
reviews.text: Definitely my new mechanic. Have used them for a few vehicle repairs and maintenance work and can say they’ve earned all of my business moving forward. They’re very direct and transparent with all expectations that they set for themselves professionally and their expectations from you as a customer. I wish everyone operated this way. Have under promised and over delivered both times I’ve used them. Transparent and great fair pricing on services offered. I needed rear brakes put on an X7 in a time crunch. They told me it probably wasn’t possible in my time frame but they’d do their very best to make it happen. Took it upon themselves to order 3 separate brakes, rotates, sensors to make sure they had the right set. Got the job done ahead of schedule. Earlier this week had an issue with my son’s vehicle stalling out. Called on Tuesday they said they could look at it Thursday informed me I could drop it off Thursday morning or on Wednesday. I dropped it off Wednesday thinking I’d maybe hear the diagnosis on Thursday and hopefully have it resolved early next week. Far exceeded my expectations they had it done and ready for pickup the same day I dropped it off. Top notch! Thank you!

reviews.author: Nancy Cunnane
reviews.text: I have been going to Carlo’s since 2013 for all my auto needs. Carlo and his team are the ABSOLUTE BEST. They provide skilled work on all vehicles, courteous and sincere respect for customers, and always fair costs. I wouldn’t go anywhere else when it comes to car care. Always good to go when I drive thanks to Carlo and crew!!!

reviews.author: AJ H
reviews.text: My husband and son recently discovered this shop, and both had outstanding experiences. The service was fast, reliable, and fairly priced. Most importantly, it was honest. I try to leave reviews that reflect the full range of service: good, bad, or just okay. This one definitely falls into the really good category. To be specific, my son’s Volvo went into limp mode, and we were bracing for the worst. He depends on that car for work, so the stress was high. Carols made time to see him quickly, diagnosed the issue, and had him back on the road without any added pressure. It was such a relief to find a place that truly cares about doing right by the customer. In a time when it feels like many shops take advantage of people who aren't familiar with the inner workings of cars, this one stands out for its transparency and integrity. We’re genuinely grateful and will return when we need help again. Thank you!

reviews.author: tolman geffs
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding shop! They’ve helped us for years, always very responsive, straightforward, reasonably priced. They listen well and we trust them.

reviews.author: Deedra Testa
reviews.text: My husband and I are so happy to find this auto repair shop. They have skilled, fair and fast service in our recent experiences.

reviews.author: Stephenie Demmerle
reviews.text: There is a reason the lot is always full at Carlo's Complete Car Care ~ they ARE that good! The service, communication and fair pricing are top-notch. In the last 18 months, my car has had occasion to be in their care four times (timing belt, front & rear brakes, sun roof drain clogged and most recently two warning lights) ~ the level of service is unsurpassed by Carlo, Zach and the team of uber-skilled mechanics. There is no reason to go elsewhere for whatever car care needs arise ~ Carlo's CCC does it all and does it well!

reviews.author: Cindi Caron
reviews.text: Can't say enough about this place! They really know their stuff, and are able to explain your car's issues in a way you can understand. Having experienced quite a few repair shops over the years, I can also say that they will give you the "straight dope" regarding your situation and the options available with no pressure. Super pleased with their work year after year?

reviews.author: Lynn Hodges
reviews.text: How fortunate to have a skilled and honest car shop here in Pawleys Island. Recently our van lost power and controls during rush hour on Hwy 17. Carlos rescued us and had us mobile again by early afternoon and even honored the warranty on an alternator. We’ve experienced this level of excellence for years! If I could give more than five stars I would. **********. Lynn Hodges, Pawleys Island, SC

reviews.author: Susan Burton
reviews.text: Carlo’s Car Care has been our family’s service center for over 20 years. They are fair in their pricing and do excellent work. Many a time I will come in and will be pleasantly surprised about the quality of work and the timing to complete it. Great place and one I recommend. Thank you Carlo for all you’ve done for us over the years.

reviews.author: Mearle94
reviews.text: I'll start by saying that I did not do business with them. But, when I accidently parked in their lot and was treated like a complete idiot because I did not see a small sign facing in the opposite direction of where I was coming from, I decided to . The person I am assuming is an owner of this business, stopped my family as I was walking from our car just after we parked and was yelling at us about it not being a lot for restaurant patrons. I was even called a loser and must be from the North during this interaction. I would never do business with anyone that treats people so disrespectfully for no reason. By the way, I am from the north but lived in the south and married a southern girl from NC and I love the South. I can honestly say that this "Karen" was ruder than anyone i have met in the South or the North. Response to Owner: Your account is absolutely false and as you can tell, I don't post Google reviews. I would not be doing this, but they way you treated my family was unbelievably inappropriate. Where I come from, people don't lose their mind over sharing a parking lot after business hours. Small Town hospitality. I never called you a loser. I asked if you were dumb because that sign that you were referring to was pointing away from our direction of travel and we couldn't even see it when we parked. And, that's when you called me a loser and said "You must be from the North. What are you going to do, write a bad review?" So that is what I am doing. But, I am not removing my post. I can tell by your response that you are still a bit unhinged by the whole thing. Never called you a liberal. Who does that? As you can see by your own words, you went off on us for a simple mistake because of past interactions with people and damage. Didn't need to be this way. Just had to say, I'm sorry guys but you can't park here. We would have just moved our car. Once again, I don't post review often and am not easily fired up. But, you treated my entire family like garbage for a simple mistake. If those reading this review would like to do business with someone like that, that's up to you. But, I think you can tell a lot about how good your customer service is going to be by just reading this interaction. An apology would be nice.

reviews.author: Robert Dannenberg
reviews.text: The team at Carlo’s could not have been more helpful. I was in a tough spot, my XTerra failed to start but had died nearby. Carlo’s sent a guy over with a jump kit and got me to their shop. Then a very nice young man replaced the battery and a failed negative cable. I was back on the road within a few minutes. They will certainly get my business for any future auto repair work. First class!

reviews.author: abagail cook
reviews.text: Worst car shop ever. They were supposed to replace our water pump and ended up causing issues with our oil system by not bleeding the lines properly after installing the water pump (I’m a female and that’s a rookie mistake to me).Then they called and left a voicemail to come get the car. We came to get the car and the engine starts sputtering. They proceeded to say the car wasn’t ready yet and we should have never picked it up. They fixed it and demanded us to pay $400 on top of the $1400 we paid the first time. $400 dollars for their lack of communication and their mistake. They made a mistake and decided to yell at us and blame us for everything. The lack of professionalism from this place is disgraceful. Stay far away unless you want these con artists to mess your car up more than it was in the first place.

reviews.author: Madalyn McCarthy
reviews.text: Now he’s saying I’m the crazy one false don’t go here. Complete false when I dropped of my car he has a sign the says $20 fee for any car and then when I go pick up my car he shows me a sign hidden in the corner that it’s 160. I never expected free work but it’s upsetting when you think your going to pay 50 to 60 dollars and have to pay 130, that’s a big difference. He was very unclear, talked over me when I had questions and was very rude! He’s charging dealership prices but he’s not a dealership better of going to dealership then his little corner shop!

reviews.author: Amanda Vibbert
reviews.text: Service was quick and very reasonable priced - handled my oil change in record time; fixed a car issue under the estimated time. Zack is also awesome at the desk! :)

reviews.author: Raymond Cunningham
reviews.text: Just left the shop with a quick, and I mean quick, tire repair. Had a small screw that they removed and repaired while I was there. Carlo's place was very busy, but in spite of that, tney did the repair right then. If I could give them 10 stars I would. No one has customer service that they have

reviews.author: B Davis
reviews.text: Best car repair spot in the lowcountry. Carlo and his crew go out of their way to take care of anyone who comes through the door, and the prices are more than fair. Wouldn't think of going anywhere else!

reviews.author: Michael Levesque
reviews.text: Carlos makes promises then hands off the duties to employees in his shop. I am sure some are quality but some are not. I waited two months for parts to come in that never did. When I questioned what was wrong I was told, do you want me to pull them out of the air? Also did damage to my trunk lid. Really? NEVER GOING BACK. Previously trusted, no longer.

reviews.author: Eric Mull
reviews.text: I don’t leave reviews unless I feel a company or an employee goes above and beyond or they really fail. Today, Carol’s Complete Car Care did a get job taking care of me. Even though they were extremely busy and I didn’t have an appointment, they squeezed me in. I needed 3 tires switched out on my travel trailer before my cross country trip tomorrow and they made it happen before noon. They even let me bring back my 4th tire to get balanced and the price was extremely fair. I moved here 2 years ago and haven’t needed anything yet for my vehicles but I will definitely be using them for my auto repair needs. Thanks for the great service.

reviews.author: Stephen N
reviews.text: Highly recommended. The day before we were scheduled to drive home from our vacation in Pawleys (over 900 miles), we had a problem with our car windows. The driver's window wouldn't close. A local told us that Carlo's could probably help us, and they absolutely did. We showed up at the shop when they opened on Monday morning, hoping that they could at least get the window closed so we could get home. They couldn't have been more friendly and helpful. A few hours later, they had a solution and we were on our way. The best part-given our situation, they easily could have taken advantage of strangers from out of state, but our bill was extremely reasonable. We were lucky to find such competent and honest professionals. Whether you're a local or visitor, if you need your car serviced, go to Carlo's.

reviews.author: Brian Squire
reviews.text: A friend and neighbor told me about Carlo's. I've been there twice for minor repairs. The first was a turn signal bulb replacement. I was shocked that you can't quickly or easily do them yourself anymore. The Ford dealership wanted about $130 to change a bulb and estimated it for an hour. Carlo's did it for $20 and took 15 minutes. They even threw in checking and adjusting my tire pressures. The second time was a tire repair after we picked up a nail. They had us in and out in about 20 minutes and it was only $15! That was the cheapest tire plug I can ever remember getting. These guys are great. Friendly, informative, efficient; they're the whole package We've been doing dealer service for many years. Not anymore with Carlo's right around the corner!

reviews.author: Susan Matthews
reviews.text: While vacationing in Pawley's Island from out of state, our van had a breakdown involving a major belt and another part. Carlo's made time to fit us into an already fully booked week, and got our van back to us in two days! Excellent service at a reasonable price. Thank you!

reviews.author: Steve Haine
reviews.text: On vacation, and with 2 days until the end, our car started to break down. We asked a couple of locals, and they both recommended Carlo's. They fixed our car by the end of the day, and were friendly, and provided a good service for a good price. I can see why they are highly recommended! Glad we chose to have them look at our car.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hutchins
reviews.text: After receiving an estimate for $650 for rear brake repairs at another location, I was told by a friend to try Carlo’s. They were friendly, professional and had my brakes done within 24 hours of my estimate, which was substantially less than $650! Car is running great and I couldn’t be happier with the service.

reviews.author: Ginger pop
reviews.text: 2-21-2022 was our first experience with Carols and for sure will not be our last. We took my sons vehicle in for its first maintenance since we have owned it and all went very smooth. I had my son go alone so he could learn the process of getting an oil change and tire rotation. They treated him very kindly and were very fast at repair. The bill was reasonable, the staff friendly, and service outstanding.

reviews.author: Tammy Ferguson
reviews.text: Great place! They do great work and the customer service is awesome. They had me back on the road in an hour and didn’t over charge me.

reviews.author: Phillip Carandang
reviews.text: Picked up a nail on my tire at 5pm on Friday. Limped my way to Carlo's to have them take a look. Carlo came out and said we'll take care of it. 15 minutes later the nail was removed and the tire was good as new. Good old fashioned service. I've been to Carlo's before for other service items. They are honest and do great work. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Greer McDougald
reviews.text: These guys are great! I needed AdBlue for my Audi and didn’t have enough miles left to make it to a local Audi dealership before my car locked down. They found what I needed that day at a very reasonable price. When I swung back by for the service, they took care of it immediately. 10 minutes in and out the door. Awesome service!

reviews.author: Alexa Brizzi
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the experiences I’ve had at this shop. The customer service was incredible, the best I’ve ever received at an Autobody shop. They were beyond willing to help me with multiple issues over the past few months with my car. As a female I’ve been to more shops that treat me like I have no idea what’s going on but they treated me so well. They gave me a complimentary scan for my check engine light and didn’t rip me off when they had a great opportunity to. I went in for a brake service and oil change, they had me on the books within two days, helped save me money, and had my car finished and ready for pickup within two hours!! Everyone should bring their vehicles here.

reviews.author: Jack Baldwin
reviews.text: I've dealt with them in both service and towing, they got work done in less than the time allotted per the service manual and charged less accordingly, recommended against unnecessary procedures, and ensured proper fluids and additives were used as per the manufacturer. On the towing side they worked quickly and efficiently to minimize my lost time, and worked fast to avoid storage fees. I couldn't give them any higher praise, except to add that Carlo and his staff are all super nice people as well.

reviews.author: Daniel Dell'Orfano
reviews.text: Carlo diagnosed a problem with my air conditioner immediately. He said that the Refrigerant was low on my 2017 Hyundai Tucson. Had it ready with 4 hours. Awesome!!!! Real cold air. Thanks Carlo.

reviews.author: Candice G. Dabbs
reviews.text: This the best auto repair shop used to be CALLED “BUCK N Carlo’s complete car care. Sadly his step father passed away many years ago. So now just ran by his step son who he favored as his own son. It’s not only auto repairs the complete part is Carlo has the top of the line body shop that is attached onto repair shop you get all your needs in at one honest place. Located in Pawleys island area for over 30 years! He is one of the few “ma & pa” places that is award winning for working on your “ top notch foreign cars” like jaguars, Maseratis, Porsche, BMW and Mercedes-Benz”. You don’t want to go to the dealership for those repairs. Where they don’t care about the cost. Of course, unless you have a warranty. Carlo is backed by Many Qualifications and certified. As well as his team! If you’re local, you probably go to him, If you’re not a local and just moving to the area, you need to go here. Here on vacation And unexpected repair Comes up Do yourself a favor go see Carlo and his team! Sincerely, a local of the Lowcountry for 31 years.

reviews.author: PD Lee
reviews.text: I recently had some major work quoted on my car at the dealership. Carlo and his team were able to do the same repairs and save me over $1000. They have been in business for a long time, and they are always busy. Great people to work with. Very knowledgeable and trustworthy!

reviews.author: michael blankenship
reviews.text: Just arrived in Pawleys for z couple days vacation. When I checked in at my condo I saw a screw in my tire. I took it to Carlos. They very very friendly and efficient. I was in and out within 15 minutes. And at a good price. Would definitely recommend and would go back.

reviews.author: Graig Davis
reviews.text: We were in the area on vacation and noticed a fuel leak. Not being from the area I chose Carlo’s solely in a Google search. I was leaving in two days and after the first day was told it was probably not going to get fixed because of issues during the repair. Saying that, they stayed after work hours (on a Friday) to get the repair complete and only charged 1 1/2 hours labor. I am always skeptical on Google reviews, but you can believe Carlo’s is top notch.

reviews.author: Lisa Bell
reviews.text: Great, fair, honest mechanic, gave us a quote for a water pump repair, they did a great job, no issues. We will use them again when we need too!

reviews.author: Chad Rowe
reviews.text: I love this place. He tells me when I'm being stupid and keeps me from throwing away money. I'm one of those people that likes to fix his own car and Carlo is always there to bail me out when I get in over my head. The last bill was a third of what I was expecting. I guess I'm just used to Nissan dealership bills always being way over what I was expecting. I love being surprised by having to pay a grand less than what I was expecting. It's a favorite past time of mine. :)

reviews.author: Dale Houston Gambrell
reviews.text: Since moving to Pawleys Island 23 years ago, our go-to for car care has been in Carlo's and his team's hands. Most important is knowledge, honesty and fair prices for this little town and we found all at Carlo's. Always congenial and appreciative of your business. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Zack Lake
reviews.text: Needed a set of new tires put on my girlfriend's car, and presumed that I would need an alignment on top of the mount and balance. Tyler indicated that they would check out the wear on the old tires to see if I actually needed an alignment. 9 times out of 10, a shop will charge you for the alignment even if you don't need it. Not only was Carlo's price on an alignment $25-125 cheaper than other places I called, but they didn't even do the alignment because they didn't see it as a necessary service. Always appreciate honesty from a shop, and will definitely be back when I'm in the area.

reviews.author: dana larson
reviews.text: My family has used Carlo's Car Care for many years and many cars. I have to brag that I made the choice to have them work on these cars. The professional way your service is handled, the quality of their work is unmatched. Think back to the days when the automobile gets the best service and the customer is well taken care of. This is what I get with Carlo and his staff.

reviews.author: Tom Saguto
reviews.text: I had an accident where my front tire blew out and I had to get it towed - I chose to get it towed to Carlo's. I use my car for business and as you can imagine, not having a car would cost me some of my business. I called Carlo to explain the situation and he mentioned to me that they were booked completely but that he would fit me in. I was extremely appreciative and the car was ready to go in one day. I could get back to my work ASAP. Also, he didn't gouge me on replacing the tire so it ended up being reasonable on the price side. I've used them before and will continue to use their services in the future - upfront, honest and caring team.

reviews.author: Alison Smelcer Close
reviews.text: While on vacation, we woke up to a flat tire so I jumped on Google Maps to start a search for a repair shop. We chose Carlo's because of the high ratings and distance from our rental. My husband backed the car up to the tire bay and our faulty air valve was fixed in 10 min. Exceptional service with a wonderful attitude. If we ever need something worked on while we are vacationing in Pawleys Island again, we will most definitely go to Carlo's!!! Thanks again for saving the day!

reviews.author: Da Ru
reviews.text: Called to see if they would install a new catalytic converter assembly I had purchased. I was asked to bring the vehicle in at opening of next business day and they would make the repair while I waited. The job was completed as promised at the price quoted over the phone. Very friendly, skilled people who I would return to in the future.

reviews.author: Claudine Eaton
reviews.text: I cant say enough and praise them enough for a great job. Called them while on my last day of vacation with a noise and they took my car in at noon and had it fixed and me back on the road so I could drive home the next day. The mechanic stayed late and worked a longer day so I could have my car. They were honest and so helpful. I wish I lived closer as I would use them as my go to. I cant thank them enough or praise them enough for a job well done

reviews.author: Marcia Caradinta
reviews.text: UPDATE: Carlo responded to my BBB complaint and gave me a partial refund. He apologized profusely for the mistake and explained the difference in cost. I really appreciate his wilingness to make this right, and for that I am very grateful. Thanks ORIGINAL POST: The only good thing I can say about my experience with Carlo's Complete Car Care is that they completed the job on time. However, when I arrived to make payment and pick up my vehicle, the actual cost was $125 OVER the quote that I was given just this morning. When I complained about the price difference, the lady at the counter politely apologized, but the owner was not brought forward to back up his reason for error. She kindly explained their reasons for the difference in cost - which should have been clear at the time of the QUOTE and not afterward as an afterthought when I had to arrive to pay. This is not the way to do business, especially if you want repeat customers. My husband is a small business owner too, and he would NEVER operate this way. I will not recommend the garage to friends, nor will I return for service. I will just have to find another local mechanic to do business with.

reviews.author: Kevin Connelly
reviews.text: Carlo"s has ALWAYS been Straight up with me . Prices are Fair and reasonable . Carlos has always made time to talk to me when I've been up there. Never hides behind staff like many places do . Always my FIRST choice in a mechanic shop . Period ! You will be hard pressed to find anyone better to deal with in my opinion

reviews.author: Damian Jarae
reviews.text: I've not been able to take my car there recently, but took both my vehicles when I worked in Litchfield. Carlo has always been honest and reputable and I've known him since high school. I always recommend his services for folks living on the South end of Horry County and North end of Georgetown. It's worth the drive to get good honest service.

reviews.author: David Hatton
reviews.text: I have a GMC truck with Goodyear tires..There are dealerships for each right here at Pawleys. But I'll be driving right past both of them to go back to Carlo's. Best people. Fairest price. Fastest service. It's easy to miss because of the trees and traffic. If you do, just keep turning around till you find Carlo's.

reviews.author: John Moses
reviews.text: Well, I’m on vacation, so it was nice of them to fit me in. They were up front about how busy they were, so I knew it would take a day or two. I needed to have a starter replaced. My only complaint is that I was quoted a price of $360-70, but the bill was $411. I would be a little more careful on the quotes, or explain and justify the difference. The guys were nice enough.

reviews.author: Daniel Sennema
reviews.text: Carlos only gets 5 stars because they don't have 6-stars available. This business is simply the best. I could write paragraphs about how the staff has gone above and beyond expectations over the years.

reviews.author: Jeff Bombich
reviews.text: I have been taking all of my vehicles to Carlo since 2005. Not only is Carlo and his team highly professional they are ethical and honorable. Those are qualities that are extremely rare in the world of auto mechanics and body shops. I would endorse Carlo without hesitation and would consider someone as being foolish if they were aware of Carlo and took their vehicles elsewhere. They will never up-sell you nor try and convince you to fix things that do not need fixed. In fact they will do the opposite, they will inform you and advise you to hold off until the time is necessary to make the repair. If you are looking for the very best place to get your vehicle fixed in South Carolina I will challenge you to find a better place to go than to Carlo. I assure you that place is not going to be found.

reviews.author: Eve Sibley
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this place. They were super helpful, positive, honest, and took the time to fit me in, and basically just showed genuine, honest care in their work and their customers. The price was surprisingly low for the service I was given too. I left feeling a boost of gratitude for good people doing good work. Thanks Carlo and company!

reviews.author: Hope Meeks Wilkins
reviews.text: Wonderful service! Even fully booked, when my engine light came on and my car was beeping at me before needing to make a long drive, they fit me in and made sure I was safe to hit the road. They were kind friendly and thorough. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kimberly Yale
reviews.text: I cannot express how wonderful Zach and Carlos treated me. Very courteous and never once treated me like a "women that didn't know anything". It was a breath of fresh air..even though they are looking for technicians they didn't use the excuse to give poor service..they just did their job. THANK YOU FROM THE BOTTOM OF MY HEART. My car is my baby.

reviews.author: Stephanie Carroll
reviews.text: Carlo is amazing! Not only do I deal with h him daily through work but he also does all my maintenance on both my vehicles! His mechanics are also great guys to speak with and listen to your issues

reviews.author: Rene Dyer
reviews.text: I have been taking my vehicles to Carlo’s for over a year now. Can’t say enough good things about the business. Always prompt, courteous, and reasonable pricing. On one occasion Carlo drove me home so I wouldn’t have to wait on my vehicle. How’s that for customer service?I’ll be taking my vehicles to Carlo’s for the unforeseen future.

reviews.author: Claire Blackwelder
reviews.text: My car started making a screeching sound while on vacation. I called Carlos', they quickly scheduled me an appointment, saw me as soon as I arrived, and diagnosed my problem during my brief wait. They made some adjustments so I could get safely home and charged me nothing. So impressed!!

reviews.author: Anna Iannace
reviews.text: Carlos car care is top notch!! The staff is friendly and always greets you with a smile.The mechanics are up to date on all the newest technolgy.we love that it is family owned and we wouldn't trust our cars to anyone else. We have been going there for years and have always been more than pleased. Carlo is an auto mechanic that you can trust!

reviews.author: JDK
reviews.text: This is a jewel of a car repair shop and a lucky find while I was vacationing at Litchfield Beach. A lowbeam headlight bulb burned out on my 2010 Hyundai Sonata just 2 days before departure. Since this was the first such failure on this car, and I was in a hurry, I checked out local shops in Columbia where I live. Verbal estimates were in $50-60 range for each side. Too expensive for me. So I decided to use Yelp and Google to search for a good shop near Pawleys Island. Carlo's looked good and I called to get more information. Carlo himself answered and he immediately impressed me. He said for me to drop by late one afternoon and he could do the work while I waited. Upon reaching Litchfield I called to confirm that the work could be done. Carlo again answered, gave the OK and even suggested that I could save time and money by buying the bulb at a nearby parts store. So I decided to get 2 bulbs and replace both sides at the same time. The bottom line is that I paid about $40 for the bulbs and only $15 for the installation, which took less than 15 minutes. Now I am a happy camper. I just wish that Carlo would decide to relocate to Columbia.

reviews.author: Jun Mortel III
reviews.text: Brought my car for tire repair during their lunch break and was accommodated right away no question ask. Very quick and honest, I didn't even get to finish my lunch. Honest and very fair.Will definitely be using them in the future. Thank you Carlo!

reviews.author: Anthony Volpini
reviews.text: Had a warning light on dash lite up. Called & was seen the next day.Being a Jaguar not many mechanics want to /know about these cars. I was amazed when they called & picked up my car & the bill/service done was in my budget. Very few mechanics are still out there that you can trust & not take you to the cleaners, this is one I recommend & you should too !!

reviews.author: allison peteet
reviews.text: Honest, fair, and a pleasure to do business with. My family has used him since the days when it was once Buck & Carlo many, many years ago.

reviews.author: Drew Albert
reviews.text: Very harding working and honest Technicians that work here. I personally take my Range Rover in for services here and other cars of mine. I take my Range Rover here vs at the Land Rover dealership because Carlos Care is by far more trustworthy to work on it than any other company.

reviews.author: Robert Smith
reviews.text: I had contacted this company for a flatbed tow service. Made them well aware of the situation and they said that it would be no problem. I even sent them a email explaining exactly what was going on. Then at the end of the day Friday I get a phone call from this company saying that would no longer provide this service to me because it was too late and too hot. Talk about customer service right? It gets worse. I was scolded by the guy who called me because he was not going to work late. I guess this company prides itself on being LAZY.

reviews.author: Miles Moses
reviews.text: Had an alignment done...quoted $150.00 for work which is extremely high< but due to difficulty I was quoted this price. Went to pick car up today to find out the bill was a $194.00. I will NEVER take my car there or a riding lawnmower, golf cart...you get the idea. I am not in favor of those who place GREED above their REPUTATION. LIVE AND LEARN.

reviews.author: Kristin Brainard
reviews.text: We had to head out of town to say goodbye to a family member. However...we could not get a flight out and decided to make the drive..The team at Carlos got us in asap even though it was last min and extremely busy....So thankful that they helped us out...An exceptional business!!! Forever grateful and will always use and recommend Carlos shop....The Best!!!

reviews.author: David Curley
reviews.text: Initially, I was close to 5 star. We recieved good information on our PPI. Had to leave for a 3 hr. drive home. Upon calling, to get the final computer results the next day, the helpful Carlo was what I call a little belligerent. Sorta condescending. When we got the car delivered the next day we headed to our Jaguar dealership. We now have a $2,437.00 repair bill. You can now chew on that.

reviews.author: Jim Fairclough
reviews.text: On vacation and leaving tomorrow and the latch on my trucks tailgate broke. I have a top on it so no way to access the bed to pack. They immediately took a look at my truck and resolved the issue. I can now enjoy my last day here instead of stressing over not being able to pack in the morning. Thanks.

reviews.author: Gary Richards
reviews.text: Had an oil change done here. Just moved to the area. They provided quick friendly service at the same price as from where I came. I am taking my car back in tomorrow for some actual repair work and will post a review of that experience too.

reviews.author: guylaine doucet
reviews.text: My tire had a leaking valve, and although I went without an appointement on a Monday morning, they fixed it on the spot, showed me how to reset the TPMS, and I was enjoying my vacation 10 minutes and 10$ later. What a relief! Thanks a lot

reviews.author: Bob Ciminel
reviews.text: Carlo has become my go-to mechanic. He services my 2007 Ford Sport Trac and my wife's 2007 Lexus RX-350. There is a Ford dealership only a quarter mile away, but every time I've taken my truck there it has been a three- or four-hour wait for even routine maintenance. As for the Lexus, we'd have to drive 80 miles into Charleston for service, which is again overly expensive. At least Carlo will give me a ride home if I have to leave my vehicle.

reviews.author: Joel Gilman
reviews.text: Great place with fair pricing. Gave me an estimate and had it done on time and the work was excellent. Will be taking all my cars there

reviews.author: Fran Bryant
reviews.text: Carlos Car Care is a rare find. True mechanics, not just part replacers. I also found it refreshing to pick up my vehicle and pay less than what I was quoted because it either took less time than they thought or didn't have to replace something that turned out to be working.

reviews.author: Jesse Ryan
reviews.text: Any time we call or have a need Carlo's has gone above and beyond to get what we need done , the other dealers and shops in our area I can not say the same for, no matter if its a simple oil change, performance part install or a 12,000$ collision repair (which I am very happy with how it looks as it did before). I will always come to this shop with all my vehicles.

reviews.author: Gavin McNeill
reviews.text: Super quick fix, blew any quote in the area out of the water. Sean and Zach were awesome guys and super helpful. Mercedes dealership should learn from these guys.

reviews.author: Sandy Griffith
reviews.text: They really can tackle difficult repairs that other garages can't. They are very busy, and that's because they are dependable. They do really good work.They will also explain things to you if you have questions.

reviews.author: Ronnie Williams
reviews.text: This crew saved me a ton of trouble. I picked up a nail passing through town and they took great care of me. They are obviously busy and could have said no but they were more than willing to assist.

reviews.author: Mike Sargenti (Mikey)
reviews.text: I love carlo. I love the guys there that do the work. They are thorough, professional and reasonably priced. They can work on anything I would imagine. I really appreciate Carlo's input on things.

reviews.author: Mike Mather
reviews.text: Just arrived from out of State and this shop went out of their way to take great care of me. Honest, skilled and customer-centric. Hoping to stay local, they have a new, loyal customer.

reviews.author: chris phillips
reviews.text: So helpful and friendly. Had an issue while vacationing and Carlo was super busy but honest and got us back on the road quickly. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Martha Castellano
reviews.text: Carlo knows his stuff. He can look at your car and tell you exactly what needs to be now and what can be done in the future. Great customer service with a smile.

reviews.author: Alwyn Staley
reviews.text: Great guys. We were down on vacation and had car problems. They fixed problem with out any issue. Honest. If you're on vac in pawleys and have problems these guys will take care of you

reviews.author: Teresa Little
reviews.text: The manager was awesome in assisting us with our flat tire on our Acura TL! We were a long way from home.....Georgia....and they made everything comfortable and pleasant!

reviews.author: JIM BIERMAIER
reviews.text: Zach is great to work with and very helpful. Great team with a fair price for amazing products/services!

reviews.author: Ashlan Simpson
reviews.text: Saved me Thousands for a car I was looking to buy. The person I spoke with was upfront and honest with the issues the car had and helped me so much by saving me future headache while charging 1/3 of what 2 other shops had quoted me. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jimmy Retired
reviews.text: These guys fixed the serpentine belt on my car and also fixed the idle pulley that was tearing it up. I really appreciate their time and efforts. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Felix Otero
reviews.text: Auto body work was done on my car. They did a great job. They did the job quicker than I expected. Very satisfied.

reviews.author: Katie Edmonds
reviews.text: Always polite and courteous; they do good work and go above and beyond what you'd expect from your average repairmen! My family goes to them for all of our needs.

reviews.author: Tammy Royal
reviews.text: The service at Carlo's is 5 star!! The people are professional and easy to work with. I would highly recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Silvia Flynn
reviews.text: Stopped in with a tire issue. They took it right in, patched it and I was on my way. It's clearly a busy place but they did this job in a friendly way. I was impressed. Thank You!

reviews.author: Carla Zygmont
reviews.text: Wonderful shop!!!! Everybody is nice and welcoming I have known this shop for years never a bad experience

reviews.author: Madison
reviews.text: You're in great hands here! Everyone is so wonderful and all our repairs were handled even more quickly than promised. Great crew!

reviews.author: Michelle L.
reviews.text: Good service, convenient and friendly. I have gotten an oil change while I waited and also left the car there all day for more service.

reviews.author: Joe Castellano
reviews.text: Carlo knows what he is doing . He has always helped me and Martha with all of our auto repairs with great service and price Highly recommend

reviews.author: Tom Allen
reviews.text: On vacation. Minor repair needed. In and out in less than 30 minutes. Nicest folks. Friendly. Professional. Reseaonable prices. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Harley John
reviews.text: Very professional, very quick. Nice people to deal with. Actual price came within a couple of dollars of the quote. Very happy.

reviews.author: John Davis
reviews.text: I have seen them fix vehicles right the first time many times and highly recommend this place. They will go the extra mile to make there customers happy

reviews.author: Rob Birchmeier
reviews.text: Could not be happier with the customer service and work done. After using many other shops in the area I will definitely being using Carlos in the future .

reviews.author: Jana Jones
reviews.text: These folks are awesome! The best customer service ever! Will definitely use Carlo and his gang again!! Very satisfied !!!

reviews.author: Edward Ingersoll
reviews.text: The best place for all your auto needs. Carlos and his crew are the most honest and accommodating auto shop in the grand stand and beyond!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Silver
reviews.text: Had a minor issue that out of precaution wanted to get checked out. Staff was very nice and professional. Will be back for future visits.

reviews.author: Scott Cantrell
reviews.text: Carlo is seemingly the most fair, straightforward and humble car repair shop owner around anywhere today.

reviews.author: ThomasEP1
reviews.text: Thank you for going above and beyond to get my family back on the road when we needed it most! We really appreciate you. Emery P.

reviews.author: Zac Sparaco
reviews.text: Best mechanic shop in the Grand Strand area, by far !!! Always a great experience, at a great price !

reviews.author: Jeremy Henry
reviews.text: Came from out of town with AC issues. They got me right in and fixed the issue. Couldn't be happier.

reviews.author: Gwendolyn Campbell
reviews.text: Really wanted to give them my business as a local from the area. We were returned a vehicle that was not fixed. I had to take the vehicle to another shop after they charged $1,000 and did not fix the problem. I really am disappointed with how this turned out.
